en: \n\nAfter a rocky start in his first game of international management <UserName> saw his side crumble to a defeat. More time working with the players on the training pitch assessing the team's strengths and weaknesses allowed them to make steady progress and get that all important win in the second game. Now he'll be hoping the wheels don't come off at this stage as he seeks another victory against <TeamName2>.

<TeamName> launched a crazy bid to land <FullPlayerName> which was shot down in flames by <TeamName2>. Although a bid such as this demonstrates the ambitions and intentions of <ManagerName>, surely he didn't think that it would be possible to land a player clearly far better than anyone on his current squad. No doubt he will be back into the transfer market and will attempt to land a player of more modest means.

"\n\n<TeamName2> have unquestionably lost one of the better performers in recent games. But will the loss of their loan player <PlayerName1> have an impact on future results? ""I don't think that my departure from <TeamName2> will affect their morale or performances in the future. I was happy to contribute to the team but they have a strong foundation in place which is starting to pay off"" added <PlayerName1>."

<TeamName1> and <TeamName2> have been held in a transfer stalemate over <PlayerName1> with counter offers bouncing back and forth between the two clubs. Neither team can agree on a figure which would see the <PlayerAge1> year old from <Nationality> move to <TeamName2> for somewhere in the region of <Currency1>. Fans will surely be hoping that the teams can agree to a price before the end of the transfer window.

The word from <TeamName2> today is that they have decided to allow <FullPlayerName> to leave the club subject to an acceptable bid being received. <ManagerName2> now has the tough task of trying to line up a replacement in the short time remaining. It is thought that the decision was made without input from the manager and it is unknown how he feels about this conclusion. All parties were unavailable for comment.

"<TeamName> striker, <FullPlayerName> will be judged on his goalscoring form for <TeamName> and not on his reputation, according to <ManagerName>.\nTalking ahead of the team's next match, <ManagerName> said: ""Nobody at this club is picked on reputation or past glories. <PlayerName> is in the team on merit because of the goals he brings us. Like all strikers, he knows what happens if and when the goals dry up."""

<TeamName1> play host to <TeamName2> in a massive game between these traditional rivals that could decide the fate of the league title. The league leaders will be tested by one of the few teams in the league who have enough quality to truly give them a challenge. A win for <TeamName3> will be another huge stride towards the title, meanwhile if <TeamName4> can pull off an upset then it will give them renewed hope.

<FullPlayerName1> has shocked <TeamName1> fans by handing in a loan request to the club's hierarchy. More shocking is that the <PlayerAge> year old <Nationality> <PreferredPos1> is one of the club's top players and even a short loan move away from the club could hurt their objectives for the season. Rumours suggest that there could be friction between him and other players at the club or even the manager himself.

<FullPlayerName1>'s international career got off to a mediocre start as his <TeamName1> team shared the honours with <TeamName2> on his debut. <PlayerName1> gave the watching nation flashes of brilliance coupled with the odd glaring error in a mixed bag of a performance. <ManagerName1> will be sure to keep an eye on how <PlayerName1> performs back at his club side as he looks towards the next international game.

Recent reports claiming <TeamName> <PreferredPos1> <FullPlayerName> is less than enamoured with his adoptive country, have allegedly sparked interest among several clubs, including: <TeamName2>, <TeamName3> and <TeamName4>.\n<PlayerName>, <PlayerAge>, is rumoured to have asked his agent to find him another club in a more 'sympathetic' country. Whether his current team will let him go, however, remains to be seen.

The future of the managers role at <TeamName2> has again been thrown into darkness as they withdraw their contract offer for <ManagerName1>. <ManagerName1> had been odds on to get the job and its thought he was even offered a contract but for whatever reason it was just not meant to be. There are a number of managers <TeamName2> are thought to be tracking and the fans will be hoping they manage to snare one soon.

DID YOU KNOW? \nYou can now play FIFA 17 using the keyboard and mouse in offline games. These controls allow the keyboard player to do things that they've not been able to do before such as 360 degree dribbling as well as making skill moves easier to perform than before. An additional benefit is that for the first time, you can use the mouse to send teammates on precise running paths and mark a specific opponent.

"\n\nAfter bouncing back in the last match, manager <UserName> was impressed by the teams response. ""I'm happy with how the team responded after defeat in the first match. Many teams would have kept their head buried in the sand but these lads came out ready and hungry to win. Hopefully we can keep this up for our third match and really take the game to the opposition"" were the words of an ecstatic <UserName>."

<ManagerName1> today accepted a transfer offer from <TeamName2> for want away <PreferredPos1> <FullPlayerName1> after the player submitted a formal transfer request a short while ago. Sources close to the club claim the player was hungry for first team football and felt he had to move elsewhere to get it. <PlayerName1> is hoping to move as soon as possible and the offer from <TeamName2> could be his ticket out.

"<TeamName2> defender <FullPlayerName2> has all the potential in the world, according to <ManagerName>, and is a player to watch for the future.\n""<PlayerName2> is a young man with a bright future,"" he admitted in his press conference, ""and it's not too hard to see him progressing.\n""So much can go wrong with young players but, if he can avoid injury, then he has a chance to make a name for himself one day."""

Two teams who have had that sinking feeling this season face up for the final time, with their rivalry the only thing really concerning them. <TeamName2> travel to <TeamName1> for this low key league game, hoping to inflict defeat on their traditional foes. With <TeamName3> having the slight upper hand in the table this season, they will be looking to keep their rivals below them in the standings once and for all.

"Defender, <FullPlayerName>, has quickly made a name for himself at <TeamName>, despite his tender years and, according to <ManagerName>, can prove crucial to the team's chances of success this season.\nTalking to the gathered media earlier this week, <ManagerName> said: ""We've all been very impressed with <PlayerName>. For a <PlayerAge>-year-old, he shows great maturity and is a tremendous asset to the club."" "

"Unusually the offer of the vacant manager's job at <TeamName2> to <ManagerName1> has been retracted. A source close to the club was quoted as saying ""In the end it wasn't the right fit. The board and <ManagerName1> didn't see eye to eye on certain things so it was thought best to withdraw the offer. There are still a few irons in the fire and you can expect an appointment to be made within the next few weeks."""

"<TeamName> fans will be in a state of shock today after reading news that <FullPlayerName> has handed in a transfer request and is intent on ending what many have described as ""turbulent"" period at the club.\n<PlayerName>, <PlayerAge> is thought to have been the target form several clubs since revealing that he disliked living in his adoptive home and couldn't wait to move on somewhere he felt more appreciated."

"<ManagerName> was quick to praise the work of <ManagerName2> when asked why he thought <TeamName2> were doing so well ahead of the two teams' upcoming fixture.\nSpeaking at a recent press conference, the manager said: ""<ManagerName2> is a class act and is making a real difference at the club. We will need to ensure we're focused because they represent a stiff test for us even though we're doing well ourselves."""

"<ManagerName> has warned of the pitfalls that face young players in today's game and singled out <TeamName2> striker <FullPlayerName2> as a prime example.\n""They tell me young <PlayerName2> at <TeamName2> is a cracking prospect but I would warn him not to get too carried away before he has  actually achieved something. So many players these days want to run before they can walk and he is probably no different."""

<TeamName1>'s counter offer for <FullPlayerName1> has been rejected by <TeamName2> local press has reported. <ManagerName2> has not given up hope of landing the <Nationality> born <PreferredPos1> and may even think about resurrecting the transfer. With the upcoming fixtures looking tricky it seems that <ManagerName1> has acquired an inspirational player who was on fire as his previous club flew up the league."

"<TeamName> took to the field for the opening game of the season without one of their star names in <PreferredPos1> <FullPlayerName>. A series of poor performances in pre-season had led to <ManagerName> choosing to leave him out of the season opener. ""<PlayerName> knows that he's not been performing in the warm up games, so we had a chat and he understands why I didn't select him today"" said the <TeamName> boss."

"Team mates as well as <TeamName> fans welcomed back <FullPlayerName> to the team yesterday. He didn't miss a beat and put in a sublime performance in <TeamName>'s win over <TeamName2>. ""I've been itching for a chance to play for weeks"" he said. ""So to finally get back out there was a blessing for me, I've not been easy to live with since I've been out, so maybe I'll be more approachable at home too"" he joked."

"In the highly anticipated %3s match between %1s and %2s, it is %1s who live to fight another day in the %6s. %5s left the field soon after the game to celebrate with his players in the locker room, but did comment on how proud he was of the performance he saw today on the field, stating ""It's an honour to coach these players, but today it was all them. It is the players who deserve the congratulations, not me."""

"\n\nAfter two draws on the trot <UserName> continued to defend his team choice. ""Many of the players are still tired from domestic duty so this is going to play a massive part in team performance. But that aside it is vital that the team does not bury their heads in the sand we will continue to push for the results we need. As long as the players give me the full hundred percent then I can't ask for much more."""

The board of directors have been shocked and saddened by you behaviour during recent matches. This must stop NOW! We can no longer tolerate behaviour such as yours at what is a family club. This reflects badly on both yourself and the club as a whole. One more outburst of this nature again and we shall be looking to terminate your contract forthwith.

I just hope they don't start that improvement until after we've played them,"" the manager joked to a football media gathering. "
